scenarios.name: mech_cooling_with_mild_oa
scenarios.description: Normal OS#3: 16 °C outdoor air against a 13 °C setpoint. Outdoor air is warmer than the supply target, so the dampers at 100% plus mechanical cooling on top is exactly the right arrangement.

scenarios.name: oat_far_below_setpoint
scenarios.description: 5 °C outdoor air against a 13 °C setpoint: the gap is 8 °C, well past the 3.0 °C threshold. Free cooling alone would overshoot, so the chiller is removing heat from air that was already cold enough. Alarms after the 30 min delay.

scenarios.name: edge_gap_equals_threshold
scenarios.description: Strict boundary, clear side: sat_sp − oat = 3.0 °C exactly. GreaterThreshold is u > t, so sitting precisely on the composed epsilon-plus-fan-heat budget is not a fault.

scenarios.name: edge_gap_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Strict boundary, fault side: sat_sp − oat = 3.1 °C clears u > t and alarms after the delay. Pins the same edge as edge_gap_equals_threshold from the other direction.

scenarios.name: fan_heat_widens_the_band
scenarios.description: Teaching case for the sign of dTSF: a 2.5 °C gap reads healthy because fan heat is added to the epsilon budget (1 + 1 + 1 = 3.0). Outdoor air 2.5 °C below setpoint arrives only 1.5 °C below it after the fan, which mechanical cooling can legitimately still be trimming. An epsilon-only threshold of 2.0 °C would have called this a fault.

scenarios.name: setpoint_raised_opens_the_gap
scenarios.description: Outdoor air holds at 11 °C while the setpoint is raised from 13 °C to 15 °C at t = 600 s. Weather did not change; the unit now asks for supply air that free cooling alone would overshoot. The delay runs from the setpoint step, so the alarm lands at 2400 s.

scenarios.name: transient_cold_snap_never_alarms
scenarios.description: A 1200 s excursion to 5 °C — shorter than the 1800 s alarm delay — then back to 16 °C. The persistence timer resets on the first compliant tick and nothing is reported.

scenarios.name: fault_clears_on_recovery
scenarios.description: Sustained 8 °C gap alarms at 1800 s; outdoor air warms back to 16 °C at 3600 s and the alarm drops on that tick. Recovery has no delay — only the assertion does.
